Name: Morning Ledger - Daily Planner and Season Tracker
Author: YGSnaffy
Description:
[size=5][b]Morning Ledger[/b][/size]
A daily planner for Stardew Valley. Every morning it opens one panel with everything worth knowing today, so you don't need a separate mod for each piece.

[size=4][b]What it shows[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Ready to harvest[/b]: fully grown crops, garden pots, and fruit trees with fruit, grouped by location. Machines with finished output can be included too (off by default).[/*]
[*][b]Birthdays[/b]: villagers with birthdays in the next 7 days. Today's birthdays are highlighted until you've given a gift, and it lists loved or liked gifts you're carrying for each person.[/*]
[*][b]Bundle items in your bag[/b]: anything in your inventory that an unfinished Community Center bundle still needs, with how many you have against how many it needs. Hidden until you can read the bundles, and on the Joja route or once the Community Center is restored.[/*]
[*][b]Season's end[/b]: outdoor crops that won't survive into next season. Crops that can't mature before day 28 are always shown in red. In the last week, every crop still in the ground is listed, so you know what to harvest.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How it's different from other info mods[/b][/size]
Popular mods like Lookup Anything, Data Layers, and UI Info Suite 2 show details about whatever you point at, overlay the map you're standing on, or put icons on the HUD. Each covers one piece, and you have to go looking. Morning Ledger takes a different approach:
[list]
[*][b]One place, once a day.[/b] One panel when you wake up, then it gets out of your way. Nothing stays on screen.[/*]
[*][b]The whole world, not the current screen.[/b] It checks every farm building, the greenhouse, and the island at once, so you don't have to walk around or hover over each crop.[/*]
[*][b]Connects the pieces.[/b] It cross-checks your inventory against birthdays and bundles: "Emily's birthday is tomorrow, and you're carrying an Amethyst" or "this Leek finishes Spring Foraging."[/*]
[*][b]Looks ahead.[/b] It warns you before the season change wipes out crops that can't mature in time.[/*]
[*][b]Works alongside the others.[/b] It doesn't patch the game or change any vanilla UI, so you can keep your favorite lookup and overlay mods.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Controls[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]The ledger opens on its own when you wake up. You can turn this off.[/*]
[*][b]L[/b] opens or closes it at any time.[/*]
[*]Click a section header to collapse it.[/*]
[*]Scroll with the mouse wheel, the arrow keys or W/S, or the D-pad. [b]Esc[/b] closes it.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i].[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer. Tested on 1.6.15 with SMAPI 4.5.2.

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
Edit [i]config.json[/i] in the mod folder, or use Generic Mod Config Menu in game. You can change the toggle key, whether it opens each morning, whether to skip empty days, the birthday lookahead, the season-end warning window, whether to include machines, and turn each section on or off.

Type [b]ledger[/b] in the SMAPI console to print today's ledger. This helps when reporting a bug.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Built for single player, multiplayer, and split-screen, with a separate ledger for each player. Co-op hasn't been tested much yet, so please report any problems.[/*]
[*]Bundles and crops are read from the game's own data, so remixed bundles and modded crops should work.[/*]
[*]The days-until-ready numbers assume crops are watered.[/*]
[/list]
Open source (MIT): [url=https://github.com/La2o/StardewValley-MorningLedger]github.com/La2o/StardewValley-MorningLedger[/url]
